notes:
Video Studio retains character descriptions and can condition later scenes on an earlier appearance of the same cast. You can also choose Add cast reference in the screenplay form to anchor the cast to your own image across cuts. Recorded dialogue now uses an expressive local voice pack when present, assigns each speaker a consistent voice and applies the stage directions to each line. Existing workspaces with only the natural speech pack continue to use their installed voices.

The optional expressive model is the Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice speech pack, revision 0c0e3051f131929182e2c023b9537f8b1c68adfe (approximately 4.52 GB in the local model cache). The Windows update contains the integration. Workbench reads the model locally during rendering.

Verified automatic recurring-character references, unrelated scene cuts, script-supplied character artwork and pause/resume with controlled footage. Source commit 1c77fbf259f81837f5eb7a9ebac42b234b8f8356.
You can now choose artwork for individual scenes, including a different angle on the same characters. The picture model receives visual acting instructions while the voice and subtitle tracks receive the screenplay dialogue. Regression tests cover scene-only and whole-cast art, duplicate or invalid scene targets, restoring references after reopening the form, and rendering the complete screenplay after a pause.
